parent_verified_state: G18P completed negative: flat 384-way workspace classification, 6 models, 2 seeds, 40 steps; ordered vs final reasoning+code gain 0.0pp and ordered IID NLL worse by 0.02394.
scope_change: New self-contained recurrent gated-delta generative probe plus scalar workspace-regression objective. This is a separately registered architecture/objective test and is not an exact continuation of G18P weights.

hypotheses.H19a: Within the G19R architecture, ordered absolute-state regression improves mean arithmetic+code IID strict exact by at least 1.0 percentage point over final-only across two fresh seeds.
hypotheses.H19b: Ordered regression beats a same-multiset order-destroying bag regression by at least 0.5 percentage points on arithmetic+code IID strict exact.
hypotheses.H19c: Ordered regression lowers IID answer-token NLL versus final-only and obtains lower chronological workspace MAE than bag on ordered targets.
hypotheses.H19d: Any gain must survive surface paraphrase and may not regress memory+list IID by more than 3 percentage points.

workspace.prompt_markers: four literal ~ markers appended after problem statement
workspace.ordered_target: four exact chronological absolute integer states
workspace.bag_ablation: the exact same four target values numerically sorted ascending
workspace.loss: SmoothL1 beta=0.1; aux_weight=0.20; final-only uses identical head with auxiliary weight zero

training.optimizer: AdamW lr=0.001 warmup10 cosine-to10%, betas=(0.9,0.95), wd=0.01, clip=1

scoring: Prompt-only greedy free generation first; EOS required; strict F=<integer>. Scorer receives no gold/case/solver. Report held splits, family slices, answer NLL, workspace MAE, paired counterfactual success, params, latency and estimated FLOPs.
interpretation: Mechanism pilot only; success cannot establish broad reasoning, Qwen parity, or the 300-800M target.
